title: Practice 2: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Эта рубашка из ___ (стопроцентный) хлопка.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «хлопка»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She is afraid of barking dogs.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «собак»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Никто не любит ___ (непрошеный) советов.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «советов»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ole Einar Bjoerndalen has won 13 Olympic medals.
exercises.ru: Уле Айнар Бьорндален завоевал тринадцать ___ медалей.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «медалей»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Из ___ (дравидийский) языков наиболее распространены телугу, тамильский, каннада и малаялам.
exercises.prompt: Of the Dravidian languages, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam have the most speakers.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «языков»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
exercises.ru: Эта компания достигла ___ увеличения товарооборота в прошлом году.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «увеличения»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: С ___ (однобокий) точки зрения взрослого дети часто проявляют непослушание.
exercises.prompt: From an adult's one-sided point of view, children's attitudes often seem to be disobedient.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «точки»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He died after a brief illness.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «болезни»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Для ___ (всеобщий) увеселения я сегодня буду в мини-юбке.
exercises.prompt: For general amusement, I'm wearing a mini-skirt today.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «увеселения»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom doesn't have cable TV.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «телевидения»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он жил здесь с ___ (пятилетний) возраста.
exercises.prompt: He has lived here since he was five years old.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «возраста»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not in our group.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «группы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Здесь так много ___ (синтаксический) ошибок...
exercises.prompt: There are so many syntax errors...
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ошибок»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мирей Матьё — одна из ___ (хороший) певиц Франции.
exercises.prompt: Mireille Mathieu is one of France's best singers.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «певиц»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я пришёл из ___ (земной) недр.
exercises.prompt: I came from the depths of the earth.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «недр»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: What are some of the side effects of quitting smoking cold turkey?
exercises.ru: Какие побочные эффекты от ___ бросания курить?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «бросания»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Если кому-то не завидуют, значит, у него нет ___ (завидный) качеств.
exercises.prompt: If someone is not envied, they don't have enviable qualities.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «качеств»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My neighbor found a cache of ancient Roman coins using his metal detector.
exercises.ru: С помощью металлодетектора мой сосед нашёл клад из ___ монет.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «монет»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том умер от ___ (пищевой) отравления.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «отравления»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is tired from overwork.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «работы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
